headline: Meta adds 3D movie purchases and rentals to Quest TV app
summary: Meta now offers more than 150 3D movies to buy or rent for viewing in VR on its Quest 3 and 3S headsets, available through its TV app. The headlining title is a Billie Eilish 3D concert experience co-directed by James Cameron.
